|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E5 (version 6 of 6) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-D-Lana_Dobreed_and_Sacrifice-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-D-Lana_Dobreed_and_Sacrifice-2022-07-05-a41bae9.png]], 5 July 2022) → [[File:V9-D-Lana_Dobreed_and_Sacrifice-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-D-lanadobreedsacrifice.gif]], 10 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 5 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Lana Dobreed & •Sacrifice]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-lanadobreedsacrifice022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/lanadobreedsacrifice.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Dark/large/lanadobreedsacrifice.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). |rulings=* The destiny draw and cost are paid during initiation, and then responses (e.g. [[Sense (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Sense]]) may take place.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Lana%20Dobreed%20%26%20%E2%80%A2Sacrifice Scomp: Lana Dobreed & •Sacrifice]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). * If retargeted by [[I Have A Bad Feeling About This]], it must EITHER select new characters to be transported OR select a new destination site.
* If using [[I Have A Bad Feeling About This]] to choose new characters, the new characters may be at the same origin site or a different origin site, but it cannot include any of the original characters.
